payload.title: [multi-region-4] Malformed-but-decodable cross-region payload bypasses the loop guard and is re-injected as a nu...
payload.description:
AUDIT FINDING multi-region-4 (medium/stability, confidence=high, verify-votes +1/-1)

FILE: apps/server/src/cluster/region-redis-bus.ts
LINES: 86-108

WHAT: RedisRegionBus.#onMessage does `envelope = decode(message) as RegionEnvelope` and then only structural check is `if (envelope.originRegionId === this.regionId) return`. Verified with @msgpack/msgpack: a payload encoding `{foo:'bar'}` decodes to an object whose `.originRegionId` is undefined (so the loop guard `undefined === regionId` is false → it passes), and `.envelope` is undefined; a top-level string `'hello'` also passes the guard. The handler (FederatingClusterBus, region-bus.ts:224) then runs `this.#local.publish(regionEnvelope.envelope)` with `undefined`. For RedisClusterBus that is `encode(undefined)` → publishes a msgpack `null` onto the intra-region channel; peer nodes decode `null` and run `switch(null.kind)` in gateway #handleClusterEnvelope (gateway.ts:850) → throws TypeError (caught/logged by per-handler isolation, but still amplified to every node in the region). A non-null garbage object with attacker-chosen `tenantId`/`kind` is forwarded verbatim. Unlike RedisClusterBus, there is no shape validation of the decoded region envelope before it is trusted as a RegionEnvelope.

IMPACT: One malformed frame on the WAN channel is amplified into an intra-region publish to every node (decode-then-throw churn, log spam), and a crafted decodable object is forwarded into the gateway dispatch with attacker-controlled fields — combined with finding multi-region-1 this is the injection vector's lack of input validation. Contained from full crash only by the gateway's per-handler try/catch.

SUGGESTED FIX: Validate the decoded value before trusting it: require it to be a non-null object with a string `originRegionId` and an `envelope` that is a non-null object with a known `kind`; drop+log otherwise (mirror the rigor RedisClusterBus implicitly relies on). Do this validation in RedisRegionBus.#onMessage and also defensively in FederatingClusterBus before re-injecting.
